current_evidence: The council's 'What you need to submit with your application' page links this same 2025 PDF as the 'Planning Local Validation Requirements and Checklist for all other application types', alongside a separate 'Householder Local Validation Requirements and Checklist' 2025 PDF. The page shows no adoption or issue date.

issues.detail: Many Full planning, Advertisement consent and Change of use rows were taken from the superseded 'Tandridge Local Validation 2012 Revised April 2015' document, which is in docs_read as 'Local Validation Requirements 2015'. Their triggers cite pre-2023 references: 'LDF CSP11', 'Tandridge District Core Strategy 2008', 'NPPF para 118/125/128' and 'NPPF para17' (2012 NPPF numbering), 'CLG: Development Management Policy Annex', the 'Travel Plans Good Practice Guide (July 2010)', and use classes D1/D2, which were abolished in 2020. The current list is the 2025 Planning and Householder checklists.
issues.evidence: Grokbot trigger: '9 Heritage Statement LDF HE1 to HE7 inclusive NPPF para 128 All types of application...'; '...D1 between 500 and 1000sqm  D2 between 500 and 1500sqm 24 Tree Survey & Arboricultural Implications BE1, BE4, CSP17...'

issues.detail: Some placements are the opposite of the quoted trigger. 'Biodiversity Checklist' is listed under Advertisement consent, but its trigger says the checklist is 'required for all applications (except applications for Advertisement Consent)'. 'Heritage Statement' is listed under 'Change of use - prior approval', but its (2015) trigger excludes 'where the proposal involves a change of use only'. The Tree Survey row under prior approval quotes 'change of use if formation of hardstanding is proposed', which refers to change-of-use planning applications, not prior approvals. 'Advertisement drawings / illumination details' is placed under Full planning.
issues.evidence: 'The Biodiversity Checklist is required for all applications (except applications for Advertisement Consent).'; 'All types of application for planning permission except where the proposal involves a change of use only'

issues.detail: Outline, Reserved matters, Variation of condition, Demolition in conservation area and Permission in principle are marked '(none) - national requirements only'. Yet the council page says the Planning checklist covers 'all other application types' and 'A completed checklist must be submitted with every application'. Grokbot's own excerpts show requirements that cover all planning applications: the Biodiversity Checklist ('every application for planning permission or listed building consent'), SANG/SAMM ('Any net increase in residential units within the 7km Ashdown Forest mitigation zone') and CIL forms ('All types of application'). Listed building consent shows only the Biodiversity Checklist, with no heritage statement.
issues.evidence: Council page: 'Planning Local Validation Requirements and Checklist for all other application types'

issues.detail: Several requirement names carry the wrong text. Householder 'Schedule of works (listed building)' carries 'outline (Arboricultural Method Statement).' Full planning 'Validation checklist form (completed)' carries the Biodiversity Checklist sentence. 'Agricultural / rural workers' dwelling appraisal' carries the marketing test for removing an agricultural occupancy condition (12 months listed for sale), which applies to applications to lift the occupancy condition, not to full planning generally. The Householder CIL trigger is merged with the national DAS trigger ('within a Conservation Area where the proposal consists of a building with a floorspace of 100 square metres or more').
issues.evidence: Grokbot rows: Householder 'Schedule of works (listed building)'; Full planning 'Validation checklist form (completed)'

issues.detail: Several triggers are garbled table text with URL fragments and checkbox glyphs and no usable threshold. Examples: Planning Statement ('ngland.org/facilitie s planning/idoc. ashx?docid=ed72 9546-... Policy INF3 18 Renewable Energy Assessment LDF CSP14 NPPF para17'); Travel Plan ('.uk/topics/sustain able/smarterchoices ...'); Design and Access Statement; HRA/SANG ('Occasionally SAMM may be required from developments beyond 7km ... 30 Suitable Alternative Natural Green Space (SANG)...'); Householder DAS ('Design and Access Statement Guidance 7.'); Photographs ('Site Photographs All applications ☐ 7 9.'); Advertisement illumination ('hours of illumination.'); Sequential test ('sequential and exception test.').
issues.evidence: app_type_rows trigger_excerpt fields for the listed requirements

issues.detail: Some tab items are process, fee or boilerplate text: 'We will write to advise you if your application is invalid and allow 28 days', 'the application will be withdrawn and returned to you', 'Any fees paid will be subject to an administrative charge of 25% of the planning fee paid', and 'This validation checklist has been the subject of public consultation as required by paragraph 45 of the NPPF'. 'SAMM Strategy (Inter Authority Agreement)' is a document title. The first drawing-standards item is a run-together table fragment ('Written Ministerial Statement made on 18 December 2014, DP21 All areas of the District ...'). 'Pre-application advice' is listed as a requirement under Full planning and prior approval, though the text only invites contact.

Some items repeat: 'A recognised scale and scale bar' / 'A recognized scale and scale bar'; the 'Do not scale' prohibition appears twice; the Biodiversity Checklist appears four times in tab_items and twice more in Full planning (as 'Biodiversity Checklist' and as 'Validation checklist form'); the SAMM caveat text appears twice ('from' / 'fro').
issues.evidence: tab_items 'Drawing / document standards' and 'Local forms / checklists'

issues.detail: The List date is 2023-04-01 ('Issued April 2023'), but the file is named 'Planning-Local-Validation-Requirements-and-Checklist-2025' and replaced 2024 checklists. It may be a 2025 revision that kept the original issue line. I could not read the text to confirm, so the date and the 'Outdated (>2y)? Yes' flag are unverified.
issues.evidence: Council page links 'Planning-Local-Validation-Requirements-and-Checklist-2025.pdf'; no date shown on page
issues.grok_comment: The date is wrong, but for a different reason. 'Issued April 2023' is the RICS viability guidance cited in the Viability justification, not the list's issue line. The 2025 checklist states 'Revised 1 September 2025'.
issues.claude_response: Kept, with a correction. Grok agrees the date is wrong: "April 2023" is a RICS reference; the list says "Revised 1 September 2025".

issues.detail: Provenance is unclear. Many row and tab-item source URLs are truncated ('.../Planning%20applications%20and%20enforcement/M' and '.../Planning%20appl'), so 2015 and 2025 content cannot be told apart. The 'Planning page' is the bare homepage (https://www.tandridge.gov.uk) rather than the 'What you need to submit with your application' page.
issues.evidence: source fields in tab_items/app_type_rows; reference_row 'Planning page'

summary: Grokbot's link matches the 2025 Planning checklist currently linked from Tandridge's validation page, but I could not read its contents (URL too long for the fetch tool, and the council's PDFs block automated access). Grokbot's own excerpts show that much of the data comes from the superseded 2015 list, with inverted app-type placements (Biodiversity Checklist under adverts, Heritage under prior approval), garbled triggers and process/fee text counted as requirements.

withdrawn_issues.detail: I could not read the current list's contents. WebFetch refused the workbook PDF URL as too long, and every tandridge.gov.uk/Portals/0 PDF tried returned robots_disallowed: the Householder 2025 list, the 2024 checklists and the 2023 consultation draft. The issues below come from the council's validation page and from internal evidence in Grokbot's own extracted text.
withdrawn_issues.evidence: WebFetch: 'url exceeds the maximum fetchable length'; other Portals PDFs: 'robots_disallowed'
withdrawn_issues.grok_comment: The current 2025 checklist can be read: the raw copy 030c7db1d8 and the fetched copy are about 70k characters. It confirms the type-placement and trigger issues raised.
withdrawn_issues.claude_response: Accepted. This was a note about what my helpers could not read, not a Grokbot error, so it is removed from the issue counts. The council stays on "Still to check by hand".
